name: cell_flow
desc: A high-performance reactive orchestration layer for the Cell framework (codename Mitosis).

name: CellFlowOperators
desc: Fluent wrappers around the authoritative Flow static factories.

name: Flow
desc:
The Transcription Orchestrator for the Cell framework, responsible for
converting (transcribing) external stimuli, persistent state, and logic
into reactive Cell topographies.

name: asyncExpand
desc: Flatten an inner sequence per payload (Dart asyncExpand).

name: asyncExpandConcurrent
desc: Concurrent flatten.

name: asyncExpandExhaust
desc: Exhaust flatten — ignore while busy.

name: asyncExpandLatest
desc: Switch flatten — drop the previous inner.

name: asyncFold
desc: Async running fold (queued).

name: asyncFoldExhaust
desc:
Similar to asyncFold, but ignores new triggers while an inner
accumulation is already running.

name: asyncFoldLatest
desc: Similar to asyncFold, but only processes the latest pulse.

name: asyncMap
desc: Maps each payload through an asynchronous mapper.

name: asyncMapConcurrent
desc: Similar to asyncMap, but processes pulses concurrently as they arrive.

name: asyncMapLatest
desc: Similar to asyncMap, but only processes the latest pulse.

name: asyncMapWithFallback
desc: Emit fallback when the mapper throws.

name: asyncMapWithIndex
desc: Async map with a 0-based index.

name: asyncMapWithRetry
desc: Retry the mapper up to count extra times.

name: asyncMapWithTimeout
desc: Time-box one projection.

name: asyncReduce
desc: First value is the seed; later values accumulate.

name: audit
desc: After a source value, emit it on the next notifier pulse.

name: auditTime
desc: Emit the latest value duration after a source move.

name: bufferCount
desc: Collects payloads into a list and emits it once it reaches size (Rx bufferCount).

name: bufferTime
desc: Periodically flushes the collected payloads into a list and emits it (Rx bufferTime).

name: bufferWhen
desc: Flush when closer pulses.

name: bufferWithPredicate
desc: Close the buffer when test is true.

name: bufferWithTimeAndCount
desc: Flush on count or duration.

name: combineLatestWith
desc:
Combines the latest value from source with the latest values from
others whenever any of them emit.

name: concat
desc: Play static inners after the first pulse (Rx concat).

name: concatAll
desc: Each payload is an inner, queued (Rx concatAll).

name: concatLatest
desc: Last item of each inner.

name: concatMap
desc:
Maps each payload to an inner sequence and flattens them sequentially
(Rx concatMap).

name: debounce
desc:
Delays the emission of pulses until duration has passed since the
last pulse (Rx debounce).

name: deferFuture
desc:
Executes create to start a new future on every pulse received from
source (Rx defer for futures).

name: deferStream
desc:
Executes create to subscribe to a new stream on every pulse received
from source (Rx defer for streams).

name: delay
desc: Shift every value by duration (Rx delay).

name: delayLatest
desc: Only the latest value after duration (trailing delay).

name: delayWhen
desc: Wait for when before forwarding (Rx delayWhen).

name: delayWithSelector
desc: Per-value delay.

name: distinct
desc:
Suppresses pulses that have been seen before (globally or consecutively
depending on configuration).

name: exhaustMap
desc:
Maps each payload to an inner sequence, but ignores new ones while a
sequence is already active (Rx exhaustMap).

name: filter
desc: Only forwards payloads that satisfy the test predicate (Rx filter).

name: fromFuture
desc:
Bridges a single future into the graph on the first pulse received
from source (Rx fromFuture).

name: fromIterable
desc:
Emits each element of iterable on the first pulse received from
source (Rx from).

name: fromStream
desc:
Subscribes to stream on the first pulse received from source
(Rx fromStream).

name: groupBy
desc: Tag each value with keyOf (Rx groupBy flattened).

name: groupByCount
desc: Emit a group's list when it hits size.

name: groupCollect
desc: Running Map<K, List<S>>.

name: iif
desc:
A binary router that chooses between thenMap and elseMap based on
test (Rx iif).

name: interval
desc: Periodic ticks after the first pulse.

name: map
desc: Projects each incoming payload through the project function (Rx map).

name: mapKeys
desc: Payload is a Map; project each key.

name: mapNotNull
desc: Projects each payload and suppresses the pulse if the result is null.

name: mapTo
desc: Emits the constant value for every pulse received from source (Rx mapTo).

name: mapValue
desc: Alias of map using the MapValue name.

name: mapValueIf
desc: MapWhen under the MapValue name.

name: mapValueOr
desc: Project, or orElse when project throws.

name: mapValues
desc: Payload is a Map; project each value.

name: mapWhen
desc: Project only when test is true.

name: mapWithIndex
desc: Projects each payload along with its 0-based index.

name: merge
desc: Merge extra sources; source only arms future.

name: mergeAll
desc: Payload is an inner to merge (Rx mergeAll).

name: mergeMap
desc:
Maps each payload to an inner sequence and flattens them concurrently
(Rx mergeMap).

name: mergeWith
desc: Forward source and others (Rx mergeWith).

name: of
desc:
Emits each value in values sequentially on the first pulse received
from source (Rx of).

name: pairwise
desc:
Emits a tuple of the (previous, current) payloads for every pulse
after the first.

name: partition
desc: Routes pulses based on whether they satisfy the test predicate.

name: partitionMap
desc: Map matched / unmatched with different projectors.

name: partitionOnly
desc: Keep only the matching side.

name: pluck
desc: Extracts the value at key from a Map payload (Rx pluck).

name: pluckAll
desc: Pluck several keys into a Map.

name: pluckOr
desc: Pluck with orElse when the field is missing.

name: pluckPath
desc: Walk a nested path.

name: race
desc: First inner to emit wins (Rx race).

name: range
desc:
Emits a range of count integers starting from start on the first
pulse received from source (Rx range).

name: reduce
desc:
Similar to scan, but uses an explicit seed value to initialize
the accumulator.

name: repeat
desc:
Emits the same value, count times, on the first pulse received
from source.

name: retry
desc: Retry a failing inner.

name: sample
desc: Latest source value when notifier pulses.

name: sampleTime
desc: Latest source value every period.

name: scan
desc:
Applies an accumulate function over the pulses, emitting each
intermediate result (Rx scan).

name: share
desc: Multicasts the same pulses to all observers (Rx share).

name: shareReplay
desc: Share with a replay buffer.

name: skip
desc: Suppresses the first count pulses received from source.

name: skipRepeated
desc: Suppresses pulses if their payload is identical to the previous payload.

name: skipUntil
desc: Skip until notifier pulses.

name: skipWhen
desc: Drop values while test is true.

name: skipWhile
desc: Skip while test is true.

name: startWith
desc:
Prepends the given value to the sequence before any pulses from
source are emitted (Rx startWith).

name: switchMap
desc:
Maps each payload to an inner sequence and always switches to the
latest one (Rx switchMap).

name: take
desc: Only forwards the first count pulses received from source.

name: takeUntil
desc: Take until notifier pulses.

name: takeWhile
desc: Take while test is true.

name: tap
desc:
Executes a side effect onValue for every pulse without modifying the
sequence (Rx tap).

name: tapAll
desc: Tap every pulse, including wrong types.

name: tapWithIndex
desc: Tap with a 0-based index.

name: throttle
desc:
Limits the rate of emissions by enforcing a silent window of duration
after a pulse.

name: timeout
desc: Idle timeout after the last pulse.

name: timeoutWithFallback
desc: Timeout with a fallback value.

name: windowCount
desc: Window by count (list payload).

name: windowTime
desc: Window by time.

name: withLatestFrom
desc:
Combines the latest value from source with the latest values from
others only when source emits (Rx withLatestFrom).

name: zip
desc: Zip extra sources; source arms future.

name: zipAll
desc: Pack width source values into a list.

name: zipWith
desc: Zip source with others by index (Rx zipWith).

name: FlowInstruction
desc:
Synthesizes a Composite Logic Blueprint—a specialized instruction
wrapper designed for fluent orchestration and pipeline assembly.

name: FlowInstruction.chain
desc: Creates a composite instruction by chaining multiple instructions serially.

name: FlowInstruction.future
desc: Creates an asynchronous FlowInstruction.

name: FlowInstruction.new
desc: Creates a synchronous FlowInstruction.

name: operator +
desc: Chains this instruction with other to create a new serial composition.

name: toHandle
desc: Materializes this instruction into a live FlowHandle bound to a source cell.

name: user
desc: Custom metadata associated with this instruction for auditing, logging, or tracing.

name: user
desc: Custom metadata associated with this instruction for auditing, logging, or tracing.

name: call
desc: Executes the transformation logic of this instruction synchronously.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: noSuchMethod
desc: Invoked when a nonexistent method or property is accessed.

name: operator +
desc: Combines this instruction with another to create an InstructionChain.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: runtimeType
desc: A representation of the runtime type of the object.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: FlowOperators
desc: Pipeline continuation on a bound FlowHandle.
